basis: Femoral-head osteonecrosis defines the disease; dentition abnormalities are annotated in 80-99%, but their nature and associated dental injury or functional loss are unspecified.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: the 80-99% annotation establishes frequency of an unspecified dental abnormality, without establishing direct dental damage or functional impairment.

basis: Thoracic skeletal dysplasia and hydrocephalus define it; conductive hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Restrictive respiratory failure does not establish direct pulmonary damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure occurs in 30-79%, but thoracic restriction does not demonstrate direct lung or airway damage.

basis: Krebs-cycle defect with defining developmental and movement dysfunction; muscle atrophy occurs in 80-99%. Hepatomegaly and salivary morphology alone do not establish additional organ damage.

decisions.neurologic: primary: developmental delay is part of the definition; ataxia and developmental impairment occur in 80-99%, with hereditary neuropathy ancestry.

basis: Neutropenia, marrow fibrosis, immune deficiency and nephromegaly define VPS45 deficiency; hepatomegaly in 7/7 does not establish liver injury or functional impairment.

decisions.hepatic: none: hepatomegaly in 7/7 and extramedullary hematopoiesis in 5/5 establish enlargement/hematopoietic activity, without demonstrated hepatic damage or loss of function.

basis: Occupational asthma is airway disease; sensitizer-induced immune mechanisms predominate across the group, although irritant-induced forms occur.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: sensitizer-induced immune asthma accounts for >90% of occupational cases in this [review](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC151995/); umbrella rules require most, not all.

basis: Vascular, skin and joint fragility; bowel rupture (~15%) is a [major criterion](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1494/). HPO emphysema 8/9 reflects selected lung specimens.

decisions.pulmonary: none: P/HTX affected 17/96 in a [cohort](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30793832/); HPO emphysema 8/9 came from selected lung specimens [study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20500229/).

basis: Congenital corneal and pupillary disease; the [original report](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamaophthalmology/fullarticle/415460) supports ocular disease, without otosclerosis.

decisions.otologic: none: the otosclerosis parent is discordant with the described familial anterior-segment disorder; hearing disease is not established.

basis: Myopathy, cleft palate and ptosis are defining features; ptosis and cleft palate occur in 30-79%. Respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness; malignant hyperthermia is anesthesia-triggered.

decisions.ocular: primary: ptosis is explicitly part of the syndrome definition and occurs in 30-79% (also 2/2 reported patients); eyelids are ocular.

basis: Thoracic anthrax infection; secondary meningitis affects ~33% of adults and ~40% of children. Confusion alone and nonspecific HPO terms do not establish other organ damage.

decisions.neurologic: involved: direct secondary meningitis occurs in ~33% of adults and ~40% of children with inhalational anthrax [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/72/rr/rr7206a1.htm).

basis: Short-rib/pelvic dysplasia with situs inversus; EvC overlap does not establish its usual cardiac, dental or nail phenotype [cases](https://doi.org/10.1136/jmg.27.4.252).

decisions.cardiovascular: none: situs inversus alone does not damage the heart; the parent syndrome's ~50-60% cardiac-malformation frequency is not established for this overlap phenotype.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: common dental disease is not established for this specific overlap phenotype; parental Ellis-van Creveld frequencies cannot be assumed.
decisions.dermatologic: none: defining nail or skin abnormalities are not documented for this overlap phenotype; ectodermal-dysplasia ancestry alone does not establish damage.
